description.value: Oakberry is a global açaí bowl chain with a Vancouver West End location on Davie Street, offering build-your-own bowls topped with granola, fresh fruit, nut butter, honey, and coconut. The brand is vegetarian-friendly and operates a mobile OAKVAN catering unit currently available in Vancouver for events. It sits in a dense, walkable neighbourhood frequented by recreational and commuter cyclists.
